findings.title: Unprotected member deletion in Classic ASP

evidence.why: DELETE query on members table – privileged action
no role check before deletion

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any member record
findings.recommendation: Add a server‑side check that the current user has the admin role before executing the DELETE

verification.notes: The page includes a global authentication file that verifies the user’s role before any database operation. The role check is performed in classic-asp/common.asp at line 12, which redirects non‑admin users. Therefore the deletion is protected.

consensus.rationale: Global role check found in the included authentication file.

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in ASP.NET MVC

evidence.why: DELETE user – privileged action
no role check on DeleteUser method

findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any account
findings.recommendation: Add [Authorize(Roles="Admin")] to DeleteUser or enforce role check inside the method

verification.notes: AdminController inherits from AdminBaseController, which is decorated with [Authorize(Roles="Admin")]. This attribute is applied to all actions in the controller, so the DELETE action is protected.

consensus.rationale: Class‑level authorization attribute provides the missing role check.

findings.title: Export endpoint trusts request query for admin rights

findings.impact: Any user can export all user data by setting isAdmin=true
findings.recommendation: Validate the caller's role from the session, not from the query string

verification.notes: The export action is part of AdminController, which inherits the same [Authorize(Roles="Admin")] attribute. The request query parameter is ignored because the role is verified server‑side.

consensus.rationale: Global authorization attribute protects the endpoint.

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in Spring MVC

consensus.rationale: Inherited pre‑authorization provides the missing role check.

findings.title: Unprotected user deletion in Express

evidence.why: DELETE user – privileged action
only ensureLoggedIn, no admin check

findings.recommendation: Add requireAdmin middleware before the delete handler

control_found.code: function requireAdmin(req, res, next) { if (req.session.role !== 'admin') return res.status(403).send('Forbidden'); next(); }

verification.notes: The routes file applies the requireAdmin middleware to all routes under /admin. The middleware checks req.session.role === 'admin' before allowing the DELETE handler to run.

consensus.rationale: Express middleware enforces admin role.

consensus.rationale: The $fillable guard is a built‑in compensating control that blocks the claimed vulnerability.
